limitations: Fixture is the upstream ExecuTorch linear toy model lowered to XNNPACK FP32, not a gpt-oss/GGUF LLM; B02 measures backend viability on an equivalent operator fixture.
Hot 40i thermal sysfs glob returned empty values through adb shell, so B02 records meminfo/RSS and notes thermal as unavailable for this fixture.
